Since it's Friday evening, Bobby Flay's Bar Americain in the Casino of the Earth is a standout choice—it is open until 11:00 PM and the bold, Southwest-inspired flavors like his signature spice-rubbed steaks are a great way to start the weekend. The atmosphere is sophisticated but high-energy, and while they accept walk-ins, reservations are usually recommended for dinner on a night like tonight.

If you prefer something else, Ballo Italian Restaurant in the Casino of the Sky serves incredible housemade pasta until 10:00 PM, or Lantern Bar & Grill offers a full American menu 24 hours a day. Pro tip: if you're dining at Bar Americain, the shellfish platters are an insider favorite for sharing at the start of the meal. 

After your dinner, the Wolf Den usually has great live music and it's located right in the heart of the Casino of the Earth. Are you in the mood for a formal sit-down experience, or are you looking for a quicker bite so you can get back to the gaming floor?
